world_weapons_atlas.prompt: Production WORLD WEAPON SPRITE ATLAS for Moss Circuit pixel-inspired top-down action game. Six separate standalone equipment sprites, exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, 3:2 landscape canvas, generous 18% transparent margins in EACH cell. No UI icon card, no border, no circular backdrop, no text, no labels, no hands, no character, no muzzle flash or effects. Genuine transparent background. Moss-green worn industrial metal, brass amber accents, dark charcoal outlines, chunky stepped pixels, orthographic nearly side-on view for guns all aiming horizontally RIGHT. Row-major: top left compact industrial RIVET GUN with stubby narrow barrel and small underslung rivet magazine; top middle SCRAP SHOTGUN with two thick parallel short barrels and pump grip, visibly wide silhouette; top right RAIL LANCE long slim twin rails and amber coil, longest gun. Bottom left ORBIT SAW circular steel toothed blade face-on with small moss mechanical center hub, no handle; bottom middle RETURN DISC face-on three curved triangular blades around moss/brass circular hub distinct from saw teeth; bottom right SHOCK MORTAR compact thick short barrel facing right, chunky boxy chamber and coil, shorter and bulkier than shotgun. Every object isolated on transparency within its own cell, object centered. Six unique readable world asset silhouettes, not menu illustrations. Match clean moss scavenger robot palette.
